metadata.title: Nvidia Stock Falls in Early Trading

content.text:
14 min ago
Nvidia slipped 0.3% to $212.42 at Wednesday's opening bell, as investors wait for the chip maker's fiscal second-quarter earnings report to be released after the market close.
The results will be an indicator of the health of the artificial-intelligence trade, which has dominated markets for more than a year. In the meantime, investors are taking a breath. The major stock indexes were mixed shortly after the open.
The iShares Semiconductor exchange-traded fund, which counts Nvidia as its largest holding, was about flat.
